import Shao.Probability.SourcePermutationReveal

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Shao.C2.AdaptiveRevealCutoff
open Shao.Probability.SourcePermutationReveal

theorem before_adaptive_cutoff_iff
    {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (m r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) (sigma : LabelPerm n) :
    r < min (energyCutoff a H sigma) (n - m) ↔
      r < n - m ∧ H ≤ remainingEnergy a r sigma := by
  have hc := (energy_cutoff_data a H hH).2.1 sigma r hr
  rw [lt_min_iff]
  have he : r < energyCutoff a H sigma ↔ H ≤ remainingEnergy a r sigma := by
    simpa only [not_le, not_lt] using not_congr hc
  rw [he]
  exact and_comm

theorem omitted_adaptive_cutoff_iff
    {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (h0 H : ℝ) (hh0 : 0 < h0) (hH : 0 < H)
    (m r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) (sigma : LabelPerm n) :
    (min (energyCutoff a H sigma) (n - m) ≤ r ∧ r < energyCutoff a h0 sigma) ↔
      h0 ≤ remainingEnergy a r sigma ∧
        (remainingEnergy a r sigma < H ∨ n - r ≤ m) := by
  have hcH := (energy_cutoff_data a H hH).2.1 sigma r hr
  have hc0 := (energy_cutoff_data a h0 hh0).2.1 sigma r hr
  have he0 : r < energyCutoff a h0 sigma ↔ h0 ≤ remainingEnergy a r sigma := by
    simpa only [not_le, not_lt] using not_congr hc0
  rw [min_le_iff, hcH, he0]
  have hNat : n - m ≤ r ↔ n - r ≤ m := by omega
  rw [hNat]
  exact and_comm

theorem adaptive_cutoff_stopping_and_le
    {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (h0 H : ℝ) (hh0 : 0 < h0) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hh0H : h0 ≤ H) (m : ℕ) :
    IsRevealStoppingRank (fun sigma => min (energyCutoff a H sigma) (n - m)) ∧
      ∀ sigma : LabelPerm n,
        min (energyCutoff a H sigma) (n - m) ≤ energyCutoff a h0 sigma := by
  have hDataH := energy_cutoff_data a H hH
  have hData0 := energy_cutoff_data a h0 hh0
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro sigma
      exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hDataH.1.1 sigma)
    · intro r sigma tau hprefix
      simp only [min_le_iff]
      exact or_congr (hDataH.1.2 r sigma tau hprefix) Iff.rfl
  · intro sigma
    have hAt0 : remainingEnergy a (energyCutoff a h0 sigma) sigma < h0 :=
      ((hData0.2.1 sigma (energyCutoff a h0 sigma) (hData0.1.1 sigma))).mp le_rfl
    have hLe : energyCutoff a H sigma ≤ energyCutoff a h0 sigma :=
      ((hDataH.2.1 sigma (energyCutoff a h0 sigma) (hData0.1.1 sigma))).mpr
        (hAt0.trans_le hh0H)
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hLe

end Shao.C2.AdaptiveRevealCutoff

boundaryReview.actualEnergy: remainingEnergy a r sigma = Shao.energy a - Shao.prefixSquares (Spitzer.reorder a sigma) r, same labeled population/permutation, actual squared values, no centering or deterministic variance replacement.
boundaryReview.firstPassage: energyCutoff is first r<=n with strict T_r<H; positive thresholds guarantee existence through accepted producer. Thus before-cutoff energy is closed H<=T_r, not strict H<T_r.
boundaryReview.quantifiers: Every n, every finite path a, arbitrary natural m, every r<=n and every label permutation. Thresholds positive as explicit binders; h0<=H only in nesting theorem. No conditional probability assumption is added to deterministic statements.
boundaryReview.nZero: Then r=0 and remaining energy=0; both positive-threshold cutoffs and adaptive rank are0. Before and omitted intervals are empty, both right sides false; stopping/nesting hold.
boundaryReview.mZero: n-m=n; min with n leaves the H cutoff, with n bound supplied by producer. At r=n the positive h0<=remaining energy condition is false.
boundaryReview.mAtLeastN: Natural n-m=0, adaptive rank0; before interval empty and n-r<=m true for r<=n, so omitted iff h0<=T_r, exactly as derived.
boundaryReview.rN: Both thresholds cut off by n; r<cutoffh0 false and T_n=0<h0, no terminal off-by-one.
boundaryReview.energyEquality: T_r=H remains before energy cutoff; T_r=h0 remains before h0 cutoff. The proof uses closed lower inequalities and strict T<H exactly.
boundaryReview.h0GreaterH: Allowed for omitted identity; small-energy branch is then incompatible with h0<=T, but short-suffix branch may remain. Ordering is assumed only for nesting.
boundaryReview.revealInformation: IsRevealStoppingRank is pointwise invariance under first-r label agreement after conditioning on a full fixed labeled sample. No natural iid-filtration stopping-time or new seed independence theorem is claimed.
